full_judgment: 2. Background of the case is that the respondent no.1 herein as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.78 of 2023 in the Court-of learned Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka for declaration and partition, contending interalia, that Mrs. Layla Sikdcr, Mother of the plaintiff and defendant no.1, obtained title of the suit schedule 'Ka' land vide registered Sale Deed No.9195 dated 20.12.1972 from the original lessee of the land Wakil Ahmed; City Jorip Khatian No.1234 of the 'Ka' schedule land was correctly published in her name; Plaintiff and defendant no.1 used to stay in the land with their mother; Said land was rented to the Iranian Culture Centre since 01.11.2013 and the centre was there till 2021; Mother of the plaintiff used to reside there with the defendant no.1; Mother of the plaintiff had to undergone glaucoma operation and upon two successive operation in 2010 and 2011, she lost her eye sight; Between 2008-2016 the plaintiff has visited Singapore on numerous occasions for treatment of heart disease; Taking advantage of the ill health of their mother as well as plaintiff, the defendant no.1 managed to procure the deed in question relating to schedule 'Ka' land by practicing fraud; Similarly schedule 'Kha' apartment was also obtained by practicing fraud. After demise of the plaintiffs mother all on a sudden the building of the-schedule 'Ka' land was demolished.
